title: 2026 Jiya Cup Bay Area Individual Singles Tournament — Platinum Tiger Final
content: The final takes place this Sunday, October 18, at 2 p.m. at Kona Kai. Bay Area standout Yong Guo, nicknamed “Boss Guo,” will face a challenge from young player Nan Sun, nicknamed “Sonic.” This Platinum division showdown between two male players rated around UTR 7 promises exciting tennis. Join the Bay Area tennis discussion group to predict the score for a chance to win an 8888 red-envelope prize.
